# CPA Class

> > Comprehensive guide to U.S. GAAP, FASB Accounting Standards Codification (ASC), and professional ethics for CPAs and accounting professionals.

CPA Class provides structured reference materials covering the complete FASB ASC framework, organized by topic areas including presentation standards, assets, revenue recognition, and business combinations. The site also includes essential guidance on AICPA professional ethics and code of conduct for certified public accountants.

## Key Topics

- U.S. GAAP
- FASB Accounting Standards Codification (ASC)
- ASC Topic 200 (Presentation)
- ASC Topic 300 (Assets)
- ASC Topic 600 (Revenue)
- ASC Topic 800 (Broad Transactions)
- Financial Statement Presentation
- Financial Reporting Standards
- AICPA Professional Ethics
- Code of Conduct for CPAs
- GAAP Codification Structure
- Accounting Standards Reference
- CPA Professional Standards

## GAAP Codification Overview

- [U.S. GAAP Codification of Accounting Standards Guide](https://www.cpaclass.com/gaap-accounting-standards/gaap-codification-asc-overview.htm): Overview of FASB ASC Topics and U.S. GAAP Codification structure

## ASC Topic Indexes

- [ASC Topic 200 Index - Presentation Standards](https://www.cpaclass.com/gaap-accounting-standards/codification-200/asc-codification-200-index.htm): ASC Topic 200 index for presentation and financial statement standards
- [ASC Topic 300 Index - Assets](https://www.cpaclass.com/gaap-accounting-standards/codification-300/asc-codification-300-index.htm): ASC Topic 300 index covering assets accounting standards
- [ASC Topic 600 Index - Revenue](https://www.cpaclass.com/gaap-accounting-standards/codification-600/asc-codification-600-index.htm): ASC Topic 600 index for revenue recognition standards
- [ASC Topic 800 Index - Broad Transactions](https://www.cpaclass.com/gaap-accounting-standards/codification-800/asc-codification-800-index.htm): ASC Topic 800 index for broad transactions and business combinations

## Professional Ethics & Conduct

- [AICPA Professional Ethics Guide](https://www.cpaclass.com/ethics/): AICPA professional ethics and code of conduct guide for CPAs
